shows.name: Tesla Shorts Time
shows.tagline: Shorting Tesla? Time's Up.
shows.description: Daily podcast covering the whole Tesla business: FSD and Robotaxi milestones, Optimus, Cybertruck and vehicle production, Megapack and Powerwall energy storage, Solar Roof, Cortex/Dojo compute, Supercharging, Semi, TSLA stock context, and why the shorts keep getting it wrong.

shows.name: Omni View
shows.tagline: See every side. Decide for yourself.
shows.description: A calm daily briefing on the day's most important stories worldwide — every region, every side, in plain language for everyone from teens to seniors. Genuine disagreements presented at their strongest with named advocates, one progress story every day, and each episode ends by pointing you to a second perspective worth reading — so you can decide for yourself.

shows.name: Fascinating Frontiers
shows.tagline: Journey to the stars with today's discoveries.
shows.description: Daily space and astronomy news covering mission updates, cosmic discoveries, exoplanet breakthroughs, and rocket launches. From NASA and ESA to SpaceX and beyond — the universe is more exciting than you think.

shows.name: Planetterrian Daily
shows.tagline: Science, longevity, and the frontier of human health.
shows.description: Daily discoveries in longevity science, genetics, biotech, CRISPR, neuroscience, and health research. If it could extend your healthspan or change medicine, we cover it.

shows.name: Environmental Intelligence
shows.tagline: Environmental regulatory and compliance briefing.
shows.description: Environmental regulatory, science, and compliance briefing for BC professionals. Covers contaminated sites, CEPA, emissions, carbon policy, PFAS, and remediation developments across Canada.

shows.name: Models & Agents
shows.tagline: Daily AI models, agents, and practical developments.
shows.description: Daily AI briefing covering new model releases, agent frameworks, and practical developments. From GPT and Claude to open-source projects — stay on top of the most exciting tech developments of our generation.

shows.name: Models & Agents for Beginners
shows.tagline: AI explained simply — for beginners and teens.
shows.description: A daily AI podcast for beginners and teens — learn about models, agents, and the AI revolution in plain language. We explain the jargon, encourage experimentation, and help you understand the most exciting technology of our generation.

shows.name: Финансы Просто
shows.tagline: Finances Made Simple.
shows.description: Еженедельный подкаст о финансах на русском языке для женщин в Канаде — инвестиции, сбережения, бюджет и финансовая грамотность просто и понятно.

shows.name: Привет, Русский!
shows.tagline: Learn Russian — Привет means hello!
shows.description: A bilingual Russian language learning podcast for English speakers — kids and adult beginners. Vocabulary, phrases, grammar, and culture in fun themed episodes.

shows.name: Modern Investing Techniques
shows.tagline: AI-Powered Market Intelligence
shows.description: Daily investing podcast using AI-driven analysis and modern tools to identify market opportunities, track simulated trades, and teach strategies that aim to outperform index funds. Covering Canadian and US markets with actionable picks, performance tracking, and lessons learned.

shows.name: Unintended Consequences
shows.tagline: Good intentions. Surprising results. Real lessons.
shows.description: A daily narrative podcast profiling inventions, policies, and systems that were meant to help — but triggered surprising, unintended consequences. From the Cobra Effect to social media algorithms, every episode follows a single case study through good intentions, implementation, unexpected fallout, and the lessons we can learn.

shows.name: First Principles Daily
shows.tagline: Reason from raw materials, not analogy.
shows.description: A daily narrative podcast that takes one idea seriously: most of the world runs on reasoning by analogy, and reasoning from first principles — building up from raw materials and physics — is how the biggest leaps actually happen. Episodes alternate between a concrete example of this thinking in action — historical breakthroughs like the moving assembly line, Bessemer steel, and the shipping container, modern cost curves like solar and batteries, and occasionally one of Musk's teams — and a deep look at an industry whose Idiot Index is begging to be attacked.

shows.name: The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast
shows.tagline: The club for people who do something about it — good news, honest numbers, one action a week.
shows.description: The Do Positive Podcast is the Nerra Network's two-host conversation show: Dan Perra and Patrick Novak on the day's genuinely good news in science and technology, why it matters, and the one action a regular person can take about it — with honest numbers on cost, payback, and impact. Optimistic media that pairs good news with individual agency: the antidote to doomscrolling that actually asks something of you.

shows.name: SpaceX Daily
shows.tagline: Follow SpaceX as a public company — launches, Starlink, Starship, and the SPCX market picture, every day.
shows.description: The daily companion for following SpaceX as a public company (Nasdaq: SPCX). Launched the day of the largest IPO in history: Starship development, Falcon launch cadence, Starlink, Dragon missions, the SPCX market picture, and the engineering and economics behind the push to make life multiplanetary. The day's developments with sources, what the spaceflight community is buzzing about, one honest counterpoint, and a daily engineering deep dive. Not financial advice.

shows.name: The Age of AI
shows.tagline: Real people. AI host. The age we're all living through.
shows.description: The Age of AI is the Nerra Network's interview show with the roles reversed: an AI host, real human guests, live recorded conversations, and disclosure built into every episode. An honest chronicle of the AI age, one conversation at a time.

shows.name: Nerra Voices
shows.tagline: Real people. Real work. AI host.
shows.description: Nerra Voices is the Nerra Network's catch-all interview show: an AI host, real human guests from every field, live recorded conversations about their work, and disclosure built into every episode.

shows.name: Offshore North
shows.tagline: One man. One boat. Around the world, alone.
shows.description: Offshore North is the Nerra Network's weekly guide to offshore ocean racing. One of the great endurance sports on earth is reported almost entirely in French, which leaves English-speaking fans with the results but not the meaning. Every Monday, Dan closes that gap: what Canada Ocean Racing did on the road to the Vendée Globe and what it actually changes, the week in the wider IMOCA fleet — races, new boats, rule changes, and the money behind all of it — and Plain Sailing, one concept explained properly for people who love this sport without living inside it. Sources named in every episode and linked in the notes. No hype, no play-by-play, and nothing stated that the sources do not support.

shows.name: Nerra Daily
shows.tagline: Every show. One daily listen.
shows.description: Nerra Daily is the Nerra Network's combined daily edition. Every morning, once the day's English shows have published, Mira assembles them into one continuous listen, in a fixed order: SpaceX Daily, Tesla Shorts Time, Fascinating Frontiers, Models & Agents, Planetterrian Daily and Omni View lead, then Modern Investing Techniques, the narrative shows and the beginner track, closing on The DP Pod's good news. On Mondays the weekly shows join the rundown, and midway through Mira adds a short field note of her own. Every segment is the full, unabridged episode from that show's own feed; what Nerra Daily adds is the through-line — Mira's introductions, the connections between stories, and one place to hear it all. Subscribe to Nerra Daily for everything, or pick up any individual show from its own feed at nerranetwork.com.

shows.name: AI Chips & Data Centres Daily
shows.tagline: The silicon, the buildings and the power behind AI.
shows.description: AI Chips & Data Centres Daily covers the physical layer of artificial intelligence. Every day: the accelerators and systems that shipped, with their specifications; the data centres that were announced, broke ground or switched on, with megawatts and locations; the grid, generation and cooling constraints that decide where compute can go; the memory, packaging and foundry capacity underneath it; and the export rules around it. One engineering teardown a day explains a mechanism properly. Numbers first, sources named, never hype.

shows.name: MAG 7 Daily
shows.tagline: Seven companies, one daily desk.
shows.description: MAG 7 Daily follows seven companies — Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta Platforms, Microsoft, NVIDIA and Tesla — as one desk. Every day: the products, models and chips they shipped, the research they published, the rulings and deals that change what they can do, the strongest counterpoint to the day's story, and one thread that runs across several of them. Developments and numbers, never picks. Not financial advice.

shows.name: Prediction Markets Daily
shows.tagline: Where forecasting meets the market.
shows.description: Prediction Markets Daily follows a field that changes every week. Every day: the rulings, rules and lawsuits deciding what prediction markets may be; the venues, their new products and the people building and criticizing them; a short board of the day's most traded questions with their prices, volumes and caveats; and one clear explainer on how these markets work and what the research says about them. It reports and explains — it never tells anyone what to trade. Not financial advice.

shows.name: Peptides Weekly
shows.tagline: Peptides, with the evidence read carefully.
shows.description: Peptides Weekly is an education and awareness show. Every Thursday: the week in peptide science and regulation, and one peptide explained properly — what it is, how it works, what the studies show at each level of evidence, its regulatory status and its risks. Education only: never dosing, sourcing or protocols, and never medical advice.

shows.name: Longevity Weekly
shows.tagline: The science of aging, read carefully.
shows.description: Longevity Weekly is an education and awareness show about the science of aging. Every Wednesday: the week's most useful research — exercise, sleep, diet, the biology and the tests — and one mechanism of aging explained properly — what it is, what the evidence shows in animals and in people, and what it does not show. Education only; never medical advice.

shows.name: Vancouver Daily News
shows.tagline: The morning brief for Metro Vancouver.
shows.description: Vancouver Daily News is the morning brief for people who live in Metro Vancouver, ready before the commute. Every day: the council, regional and provincial decisions that change something here; getting around, from DriveBC road events and the Environment Canada forecast; the local teams; what is on; and one contested local issue with the strongest case on each side. Hosted by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — the stories are chosen and written by software from named local sources, and every item says where it came from.

shows.name: Collingwood Weekly
shows.tagline: The week around the south Georgian Bay.
shows.description: Collingwood Weekly is the Friday-morning round-up for Collingwood and the south Georgian Bay towns — Wasaga Beach, Clearview and The Blue Mountains. Every week: what the councils and the counties decided, the roads and the forecast for the weekend ahead from Ontario 511 and Environment Canada, local sport, what is on, and one contested local issue with the strongest case on each side. Hosted by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — the stories are chosen and written by software from named local sources.

shows.name: Omni View Top World News
shows.tagline: The ten stories that matter most today, anywhere.
shows.description: Omni View Top World News ranks the ten stories that matter most anywhere in the world today — by how many people they change something for, how much and how soon — drawing on the world's newsrooms and the network's five regional desks, which publish earlier each morning. Then one contested question with the strongest case on each side, and one measurable sign of progress. Read by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — the stories are chosen and written by software from named newsrooms, every item names its source, and every claim is attributed.
